brief: A drawer to keep my kitchen knives and a sharpening steel in.

requirements.evidence: Long drawer drawer:0#1,0#cut (w:long) on two half-e bases piece:1,0,0 and piece:2,0,0, opened and staged with one visible knife prop:1. Its two 115x64mm compartments are shorter than a 225mm knife prop / typical chef's knife, so long knives overhang / do not fit fully inside as shown by refused placements; the drawer suits shorter kitchen knives.

requirements.requirement: Space for a sharpening steel alongside
requirements.evidence: Drawer has a second compartment intended for the steel, but no sharpening-steel prop exists (only a 300mm steel rule), and a 300mm item exceeds the 115mm compartment; a steel longer than the compartment will not fit fully inside.

requirements.requirement: House rules: cap open faces and lock joints, then verify
requirements.evidence: capOpenFaces added 4 solid caps, lockJoints applied, check_build ok with meshClash clear and no issues.

finish.summary: Built an open long drawer on two half-e bases, capped and locked, staged with one knife. Marked compromise because the hex drawer's 115mm compartments are too short for a full 225mm chef's knife or a typical ~300mm sharpening steel to lie fully inside — it will suit shorter knives, and the steel requirement cannot be fully met at this cell size.

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

result.note: A drawer sits on the cut face of a half base: place a half base first. Half-n and half-s take any drawer style; half-e and half-w take a slide, swing or long drawer (find_sockets offers those once the half base is on). No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.
